tags.Forms: Forms: list, structure, create and edit, plus field display rules, cooperators, copy, move and other related operations.
tags.Form Settings: Form settings: submission settings, access policy, Webhook, theme, closing rules, exam / evaluation scene settings.
tags.Plugins: Plugin center plugins (check-in for now). A plugin campaign is bound to one form, and only its creator can see and change it. The account must have enabled the plugin in the plugin center, or the request returns 402.
tags.Entries: Form entries: list, query, create, update, delete and batch operations, and sending SMS / email to entries.
tags.Tables: Tables (kind=table): structure and entries; field types are limited to the column types tables support.
tags.Views: Form / table views (view filters, sort, column configuration) and reading entries through a view.
tags.Fill: Fill links: read the fill page (`/f/`, `/v/`) as a submitter and submit entries through it.
tags.Account: Current user and account: members, e-invoices, payment history, SMS signatures and templates, SMTP accounts.
tags.Trade: 小金商户: merchant and onboarding progress, payment orders, transaction statistics, refunds and payouts.
tags.Uploads: Uploading attachments, form images, license images and import files.
tags.Routines: Routines (`自动任务`): instructions Jiri carries out as you, on a schedule or when data changes, and their runs. The rules and messages are those of the routines page; times are in Beijing time (+08:00). OAuth tokens need the `routines` scope. As routines run unattended and spend AI points, self-registered clients cannot get it; only a registered application with `routines` among its scopes (such as the Jinshuju CLI) can ask for it.
